name: incomingCallCard
title: Incoming Call Card
description: Full-screen incoming-call UI with caller name and accept/decline actions. Compose for interruptive or dramatic beats.

sceneDuration.description: Real seconds — drives the vibration cadence

callerName.description: Brand / product name shown as the caller. Required.

subtitle.description: Smaller line below the caller name. Default "is calling....".

declineLabel.description: Label below the red button. Default "Decline".

acceptLabel.description: Label below the green button. Default "Accept".

textColor.description: Color for caller / subtitle / button labels. Default "#FFFFFF".
